title: LBA3 Blender bridge job
description: One job, or an array of jobs run in order (bridge.mjs run <file>). Relative paths are relative to the game folder (lba3/). Inputs must be inside the project; outputs only under art/blender/ or tools/blender-bridge/.work/, and never onto an input. bridge.mjs validateJob() enforces this file by hand.

op.description: import: polyprop/glb -> working .blend (blend). inspect: report (output .json). preview: views (output folder). validate: checks (output .json). export: candidate (output .polyprop.json or .glb). script: a project-owned Python script under tools/ run in Blender's Python (args), optionally on an input and saving blend.

name.description: A label for logs and reports.

input.description: A .blend, an lba3-polyprop .json, or a .glb/.gltf. Read only; never written.

output.description: Report file, image folder, or exported file (see op).

blend.description: import / script: the working .blend to save (a copy; originals are never overwritten).

timeout.description: Seconds before the bridge terminates this job's Blender (default 600; --timeout overrides).

format.description: export: polyprop (what the game loads) or glb (interchange only: the game has no glTF loader).

modes.description: preview: neutral = Workbench, one grey with cavity; textured = EEVEE with the materials.

orthoScale.description: preview: fix the framing (metres across) so two assets compare at one scale.

expectSize.description: validate: the game-axes size (x, y, z) in metres it must keep.

sizeTolerance.description: validate: allowed difference from expectSize (default 0.005 m).

maxMaterials.description: validate: material slots allowed (one draw call each in the game).

groundedAtZero.description: validate: the origin must be on the floor (default true).

skeleton.description: validate: a skeleton JSON (art/characters/skeletons.json) whose bones the armature must have.

skeletonKey.description: validate: the entry in that file (e.g. a body name).

expectedClips.description: validate: action names the game expects.

reportOnly.description: validate: write the report but do not fail the job.

name.description: export: the asset name written into the polyprop.
